brief: Ten adventurous visual identities; creative avatars, type and colors, gradient backgrounds and typography. Earlier white-only limit superseded; no beige or purple backgrounds.

directions.name: Courier Club
directions.summary: Racing italic type, citrus gradients, articulated messenger sculptures
directions.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one adventurous, highly art-directed yet usable interface concept for HERMES STUDIO, a standalone workspace for persistent AI teammates. The owner rejected safe standard Apple/SaaS grids and cute geometric heads. Be genuinely inventive with the visual identity, avatars, fonts, gradients and spatial composition. This is a premium creative software interface, not a marketing landing page.
REFERENCE INPUTS: image 1 = actual Bots roster; image 2 = actual Echo Profile; image 3 = actual Echo chat. These are ONLY references for product functions/content. Do NOT trace or recolor their layouts. Invent the specified new structure. Do not use the previous dark rock mascot. Each design must have its own character language and recognizably different typography.
CORE FUNCTIONS: persistent team, direct bot chat, roles, memory, files, skills and collaboration. Preserve product name "Hermes Studio"; navigation "Dashboard", "Bots", "Team rooms", "Routines", "Settings"; teammates "Atlas / Chief of staff", "Nova / Creative partner", "Scout / Research analyst", "Echo / Writing partner". Use real labels "Ready", "+ New bot", "Chat", "Overview", "Brain", "Memory", "Files". A chat example can be the actual clean welcome: "Say hello to Echo", "What should we work on?", composer "Message Echo…". Keep paragraph text calm and readable even when headings are daring. Do not invent graphs, analytics or completed real-world actions. Any small example content is illustrative.
OUTPUT: landscape 3:2 concept board. One LARGE straight-on desktop interface consumes about 75% of composition, with one smaller companion view (chat, roster, profile or mobile) and an integrated strip of FOUR original avatars labelled Atlas, Nova, Scout, Echo. Small concept-number/name at the edge. Make it feel like a beautifully crafted real application screenshot, with enough visible functionality to evaluate. Do not use the same 2x2 bot-card grid plus two mini windows found in generic SaaS presentations. No browser window chrome, no macOS traffic-light frame, no laptop/device photography, no perspective. Main UI must remain the focus. Screen geometry, typography and composition follow the individual brief.
ART DIRECTION: visible intentional saturated GRADIENTS inside the actual app background and in selected display typography. Reading areas may be white; this is not restricted to white backgrounds. Concentrated colorful light, gradients, tactility and confident type. DO NOT use beige, tan, cream, sepia, lavender, violet or purple backgrounds. No standard blue-button-white-grid templates or generic pastel gradient blobs. No pseudo-English filler or illegible microtext. Colors must remain coherent and type contrast excellent.
AVATARS: original memorable character family with four different silhouettes, personality and visual storytelling as specified. They can have unexpected anatomy, expressive gestures or typographic faces; do not mechanically repeat a rounded shape with two oval eyes. They should feel like friendly capable collaborators, not hostile armor, black visors or glowing angry eyes. No copied Grok/OpenBot characters or logos. Show each at profile-scale and small roster-scale so the design is practical. Keep identities consistent across main screen and avatar strip.
The result should look like a brave award-caliber identity exploration by an excellent digital art director, with credible interface craft and production-level legibility.
CONCEPT 01 / COURIER CLUB.
TYPE: oversized tightly condensed racing-italic display letters for "Your team" and the active bot name, paired with a neutral humanist sans for chat and compact monospaced timestamps. The title fills from vermilion through orange to acid yellow. Bold typographic scale without losing readable body copy.
COLOR: bright white main reading surfaces suspended over an intense tangerine → vermilion → lemon gradient that actually occupies the app's header and side rail. Electric blue tiny links and charcoal type. Visible bold gradient, no faded peach wash.
MAIN LAYOUT: a large CHAT screen like a beautifully designed dispatch desk. Narrow numbered crew rail with large distinctive character portraits, wide central white chat folio, horizontal task/attachment slots tucked below the composer. Place "Echo" in tall italic type at the top, a compact welcome character beside "What should we work on?", and keep "Message Echo…" prominent. Companion view is a roster designed as four numbered editorial crew rows with asymmetric portrait cutouts, not cards.
AVATARS: four ORIGINAL small articulated messenger sculptures, deliberately unusual friendly anatomy: Atlas a broad chrome ribbon torso with a cobalt folding collar and low stable feet; Nova a red bent-loop body with a floating circular stamp head and elegant long arms; Scout a slim angular yellow messenger with a long telescopic neck and one bright lens; Echo a compact orange folded-foil bird courier with a curled tail. Small colored satchel/stamp geometry is integrated into their bodies, not costumes. Personality through curious postures and expressive construction, no ordinary robot heads or pasted-on dot faces. Playful precision, polished chrome plus saturated enamel accents, inspired by excellent kinetic sculpture rather than toys. Original compact messenger-wing Hermes mark.

CONCEPT 02 / INK CURRENT.
TYPE: expressive bold black brush lettering for "Your team" and "Echo", with a sharply contrasting precise modern grotesk for every working label. Brush heading edges are beautifully controlled, not distressed. Selected large name lettering uses a cyan → ultramarine gradient ink fill, while body text stays black.
COLOR: ice-white → saturated CYAN gradient sheets with hot vermilion red cues and dense black ink; large pure-white conversation region. No navy-purple or pale lavender. This should be strikingly graphic.
MAIN LAYOUT: main BOTS view as an asymmetrical editorial specimen gallery on a single flowing cyan field, four characters and bold names arranged on ruled baselines, practical "Chat" links and status text. No boxes around each character. A slim black vertical navigation column provides the five real sections. A separate narrow CHAT companion view is a calm white reading column framed by one fluid black ink activity trace, Echo's portrait and the actual welcome/composer. Four avatar studies sit like ink samples across the bottom.

Each is one thick continuous black brush stroke with tiny saturated red/cyan accents and expressive natural gesture: Atlas a broad looping crane with a curved beak and grounded stance; Nova a flowing fox-like coil with sweeping ears/tail; Scout an alert long-necked knot bird looking outward; Echo a dancing ribbon-eel with a sweeping fan tail. Distinct anatomy and simple sharp ink eyes or eye-shaped negative spaces only where natural. Flat editorial ink illustration with small areas of transparent color, no 3D or clay. Elegant, witty, memorable and bold at 28px.

CONCEPT 03 / AERIAL.
TYPE: monumental ultra-light EXTENDED sans capitals with widely spaced architectural labels. The main title "BOTS" is extremely wide and airy, blue → cyan gradient-filled; readable small semibold controls and dark navy body text. An architectural design magazine translated into friendly software.
COLOR: rich sky-blue → clear white → solar yellow gradient passing THROUGH the actual app workspace, with white floating working sheets and saturated primary-color kite details. White is still the main reading surface. No cream, purple, pastel beige or dark UI.
MAIN LAYOUT: main BOTS roster has four tall suspended vertical portrait columns, each with a kite avatar above its name/role/status and a clean Chat link; large typographic names cut across fine baseline rules. Navigation is a very thin horizontal top bar. Four small team portraits dock along the lower edge. Secondary screen is Echo PROFILE with a large asymmetric kite silhouette and an architectural full-width line drawing of the same character; practical tabs "Overview / Brain / Memory / Files" and clear Open chat. A compact composer strip previews the chat below.
AVATARS: miniature KITE COMPANIONS with articulated folded sails, delicate masts and short colored tails, birdlike gestures rather than human faces. Atlas broad balanced cobalt diamond sail with tiny white stabilizer; Nova two red asymmetric crescent sails; Scout narrow yellow arrow-wing glider with a curious forward nose; Echo turquoise fan-tail kite with three pleated fins. Smooth precise lightweight translucent material, no fragile fine detail at small scale: silhouettes must remain bold. Their eye/gesture cues are integrated into the mast or leading sail edge, not round heads. Miniature product sculpture lighting on white, joyful windborne presence.

CONCEPT 04 / MECHANICAL GARDEN.

Selected display lettering uses an emerald → electric lime gradient. Refined mature character, not retro beige or cottagecore.

Precision joints, tiny brushed-metal connectors, saturated enamel/glass, no weathered brass color cast. No flower face pasted on petals, no plant pot, no cute blobs. These are elegant little living instruments, with a subtle eye-like optic where useful.

CONCEPT 07 / CORAL ASSEMBLY.
TYPE: expressive CHUNKY CONTEMPORARY EDITORIAL SERIF for "Your team" and the active bot name, with chunky unusual curved terminals; restrained clean grotesk controls. Gradient typography from hot red to tangerine on white and from cyan to teal on the coral ground. A confident original editorial identity.
COLOR: saturated TOMATO RED → TANGERINE → HOT CORAL gradients cut against TURQUOISE and pure white. No washed peach background, no beige, no lavender/purple. Strong legible contrast.

Bottom avatar family is arranged like a small beautiful marine field guide.

Atlas a sturdy turquoise-and-cobalt nautilus with an architectural spiral shell; Nova a coral red ribbon-finned fish with long flowing fins; Scout a yellow-and-turquoise curious shrimp with expressive long feelers; Echo a compact red/cyan cuttlefish with a scalloped mantle and short curled arms. Faces use species-specific eyes and curious gestures. Editorial field-guide quality, witty stylization, vibrant gradients within fins, no toy render and no aquarium or ocean scenery taking over the UI.
